title: A Day at the Cafe
text:
Ben goes to a cafe with his mother. They sit at a small table near the window. The menu has pictures of food and drinks. Ben likes the pizza.

The waiter comes with a notebook. Mother orders a salad and water. Ben orders pizza and milk. The pizza is hot and very good.

questions.text: Where do Ben and his mother sit?
options: At a small table near the window

questions.text: What can you infer about the waiter?
options: He is working in the cafe

questions.text: Why is the pizza probably good for Ben?
options: He chose it and enjoys it

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks that a restaurant offers
a person who brings food and drinks to customers in a restaurant
a flat round bread topped with cheese and other foods

paragraph_translations: Бен ходить до кафе зі своєю мамою. Вони сидять за маленьким столиком біля вікна. У меню є картинки їжі і напоїв. Бену подобається піца.
Офіціант підходить з блокнотом. Мама замовляє салат і воду. Бен замовляє піцу і молоко. Піца гаряча і дуже смачна.
